description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Directions on electrical Appliances under Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003 come into effect from 01.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette contains a regulatory direction issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes mandatory compliance requirements (SLS certification and specific plug standards) for manufacturers, importers, distributors, and traders, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
